item.title: How to grep in Git
item.description: Finding specific code patterns or text across a large repository is essential for debugging, refactoring, and understanding code dependencies. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve searched through countless large codebases for specific implementations. Git grep is a powerful built-in command that searches for patterns in tracked files, respecting .gitignore and offering better performance than regular grep. This approach searches only version-controlled files and can search across different branches and commits.
